name: General Dynamics Corporation
operational_role: Primary prime manufacturer of heavy aerial bomb bodies (MK-84 2,000-lb and MK-82 500-lb) and 155mm M107/M795 artillery projectiles for the US military and allied foreign militaries.
government_liaisons: United States Department of the Army
documented_activities: Supplier of MK-80 series general-purpose bomb casings, including the 2,000-pound MK-84, which possess a lethal blast radius exceeding 350 meters and were extensively deployed in urban saturation bombing across northern and central Gaza. Also prime producer of 155mm high-explosive artillery ammunition supplied via emergency transfers.
documented_consequences: Catastrophic fragmentation damage, widespread cratering of residential neighborhoods, and mass casualties in crowded refugee camps including Jabalia and al-Bureij.
